products.name: Orthodontic Appliance Readiness
products.product: A focused orthodontic appliance delivery tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent orthodontic practices and small specialty dental groups
products.problem: Prescription, scan or impression, lab questions, ship status, appointment timing, receipt check, and patient notice can become disconnected.
products.valueProposition: Turns orthodontic appliance delivery tracking into a visible operating queue so every appliance-delivery visit is scheduled against a received and reviewed case or an explicit clinical-office decision.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets orthodontic appliance delivery tracking software, orthodontic appliance delivery tracking tracker, orthodontic appliance delivery tracking template, and orthodontic appliance delivery tracking checklist searches.

products.name: Orthodontic Record Transfer Desk
products.product: A focused orthodontic patient record transfer tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent orthodontic practices and small specialty dental groups
products.problem: Authorization, requested scope, source files, imaging, secure delivery, receipt, and follow-up are managed across portals and inboxes.
products.valueProposition: Turns orthodontic patient record transfer tracking into a visible operating queue so every authorized record transfer has a defined scope, secure delivery evidence, and verified receipt or exception.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets orthodontic patient record transfer tracking software, orthodontic patient record transfer tracking tracker, orthodontic patient record transfer tracking template, and orthodontic patient record transfer tracking checklist searches.
